notes: These decisions compare user-facing native controls against the exact desktop node descriptions, not merely shared SDK capability. Conditional group parity can cover only a subset of desktop child controls; consult each leaf.

The audit establishes implementation at the repository snapshot, not current production rollout. Device models, supported firmware, feature/message-system state, transport and network configuration still constrain availability.
Native Model One setup is explicitly unsupported. Supported model recovery takes place on device, without host word-count, standard-recovery or advanced-matrix choices.

Native new-wallet creation has skip_backup:false. Required backups from wallets initialized elsewhere can still be completed through the backup-needed banner; this does not mean native onboarding can defer backup.
Native backend configuration supports a single custom endpoint, not the desktop multiple-URL editor. Electrum is present when the selected network backendOptions permits it.
No application tests were executed and no device screens were captured for this source audit. One specific bootloader-upgrade flow remains unknown.
